svg.title: ZeMA test stand - isometric digital twin
svg.desc: Level-2 condition monitoring and diagnostic digital twin for the ZeMA hydraulic test stand (UCI 447), showing 30-degree isometric physical stand with animated oil flow, rotating motor-pump shaft, cooler fan, accumulator levels, directional valve spool, extending/retracting cylinder, sensor tags, and health HUD.

g.text: ZeMA test stand - isometric digital twin
Condition Monitoring & Multi-Fault Diagnostic Architecture • UCI 447 Physical Architecture
